name: Giant Foundling Upbringing
description: You spent your formative years living among or being raised by giants. This upbringing is available to any Species, including Goliaths, without changing inherited Species or Subspecies powers.

benefits.name: Giant Language
benefits.description: Learn Giant from the people who raised you.

benefits.name: Additional Language
benefits.description: Learn one additional language of your choice, representing the wider community or circumstances of your childhood.

benefits.name: Intimidation Training
benefits.description: Gain training in Intimidation from navigating relationships and social expectations among giants.

benefits.name: Survival Training
benefits.description: Gain training in Survival from growing up in environments and surroundings shaped by giants.

reviewNotes: Converted from the *Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants* Giant Foundling Background into an independent learned Upbringing. The original source grants proficiency in Intimidation and Survival, Giant and one additional language, and the Strike of the Giants feat.

The documented language and Skill benefits are selected for native playtest. The original bonus feat is not silently awarded: feat entitlement, source prerequisites, and duplicate/stacking behavior remain for a separate Feat reconciliation.
For a Goliath this replaces, rather than combines with, the suggested Goliath Clan Upbringing. Gol-Kaa is therefore not automatic when Giant Foundling is selected.
No non-Goliath gains Goliath Giant Ancestry or Large Form from this Upbringing. Being raised among giants does not force an actual size increase.
Original source background equipment and personal-origin table are retained as research, not independent ancestry or additional starting-inventory grants.
This record is independent of all six Goliath ancestry types and has no parent Upbringing. Specific giant communities can shape a character's narrative without six separate Upbringing records.
